Name: Autodesk Inc
Description: Autodesk, Inc. (Ticker: ADSK) is a leading American software company specializing in advanced design software and services tailored for a variety of sectors including architecture, engineering, construction, manufacturing, media, and education. Headquartered in San Rafael, California, Autodesk is renowned for its innovative cloud-based solutions and industry-leading design tools, such as AutoCAD and Revit, which facilitate streamlined workflows and enhanced collaboration across projects. With a strong focus on sustainability and digital transformation, Autodesk empowers professionals to improve productivity and achieve better outcomes in their respective fields.
Address: ONE MARKET STREET, SAN FRANCISCO, CA, UNITED STATES, 94105
